records.jp: 相容れない想いを抱えて生きても、<CR>余計な苦労を背負うだけ
records.en_original: Living with conflicting emotions only leads to pain.
records.en: Living with conflicting emotions only leads to pain.

records.jp: 一つの想いを信じる方が足は前に進む。<CR>これ以上、こんなところで足踏みしてる場合じゃない
records.en_original: It's easier to continue forward if your heart is at ease. This isn't the time to be indecisive.
records.en: It's easier to continue forward if your heart is at ease. This isn't the time to be indecisive.

records.jp: これは、想いの主である<CR>あなたたちが決めるべきこと
records.en_original: You all must decide. These are your emotions.
records.en: You all must decide. These are your emotions.

records.jp: ……さあ、どちらの想いを生かすか決めて
records.en_original: Which emotions will you choose?
records.en: Which emotions will you choose?

records.jp: 選ぶ……
records.en_original: What will we choose...
records.en: What will we choose...

records.jp: 正解……
records.en_original: Our answer...
records.en: Our answer...

records.jp: う～ん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: ……自分がスーパーヒーローだったら、<CR>こんな風に悩まないんでしょうか
records.en_original: I bet superheroes don't doubt themselves like this...
records.en: I bet superheroes don't doubt themselves like this...

records.jp: ……でも、そうじゃない
records.en_original: ...But we're not superheroes.
records.en: ...But we're not superheroes.

records.jp: じゃあ、この世界で日々を過ごしながら<CR>何か起きてくれるのを待つ？
records.en_original: Then do we just live our lives here and wait until something happens?
records.en: Then do we just live our lives here and wait until something happens?

records.jp: ……そういうわけにはいかないですよね
records.en_original: That wouldn't do either, would it?
records.en: That wouldn't do either, would it?

records.jp: …………選べない
records.en_original: I can't decide...
records.en: I can't decide...

records.jp: 選べないじゃ、ダメなのかな？
records.en_original: Do we have to decide?
records.en: Do we have to decide?

records.jp: どういうこと……？
records.en_original: What do you mean...?
records.en: What do you mean...?

records.jp: ここまでいろいろ考えてきて、<CR>どっちの想いも間違いじゃないように思える
records.en_original: After thinking a lot about things, I don't think that either of you are wrong.
records.en: After thinking a lot about things, I don't think that either of you are wrong.

records.jp: あなたたちはどっちかが『正解』で、<CR>選ばなくちゃいけないって言うけど……
records.en_original: I just wonder if our decision has to mean deciding between the two...
records.en: I just wonder if our decision has to mean deciding between the two...

records.jp: だ、だって！　どっちかが消えないと、<CR>このまま苦しみ続けることになるんだよ
records.en_original: I-if one of us doesn't go away, this pain will continue!
records.en: I-if one of us doesn't go away, this pain will continue!

records.jp: でも、楽になるからってどちらかの想いを<CR>切り捨てるのは、なんだか間違ってる気がする
records.en_original: It wouldn't feel right abandoning one of these feelings just cause it might make us feel better.
records.en: It wouldn't feel right abandoning one of these feelings just cause it might make us feel better.

records.jp: どっちの想いも、私の想い。<CR>二人がいて初めて私があるんだと思う
records.en_original: Both of them belong to us. I'm not me without each.
records.en: Both of them belong to us. I'm not me without each.

records.jp: だから……消えなくたっていいんじゃないかな？<CR>ずっと一緒に生きていこうよ
records.en_original: That's why I don't think either one of you has to go away. We can live all together.
records.en: That's why I don't think either one of you has to go away. We can live all together.

records.jp: ……消えなくてもいいの？
records.en_original: I don't have to go away...?
records.en: I don't have to go away...?

records.jp: 私たち、このままここにいて……いいの？
records.en_original: We can stay here...?
records.en: We can stay here...?

records.jp: いいんだよ
records.en_original: Of course you can.
records.en: Of course you can.

records.jp: そっか……。それでいいんだ……
records.en_original: I see... It's okay...
records.en: I see... It's okay...

records.jp: ……考えつきもしなかった
records.en_original: I guess we hadn't considered that option...
records.en: I guess we hadn't considered that option...

records.jp: ちょ、待て待て待て！！<CR>何イイ感じになっちゃってんの！？
records.en_original: Wait, wait, wait! Don't act like everything is wrapped up nicely!
records.en: Wait, wait, wait! Don't act like everything is wrapped up nicely!

records.jp: それって、今後一生こいつと一緒ってことでしょ！？
records.en_original: This means I'm stuck with them forever!
records.en: This means I'm stuck with them forever!

records.jp: はぁ……？　無理なんだけどそんなの。ダルすぎ……
records.en_original: You have to be kidding... No way I'm doing that...
records.en: You have to be kidding... No way I'm doing that...

records.jp: うわあ、なんかいっぱい出てきた……
records.en_original: Where did you all come from...
records.en: Where did you all come from...

records.jp: 無理なのはこっちのセリフだ
records.en_original: Stuck with me? I'd be stuck with you!
records.en: Stuck with me? I'd be stuck with you!

records.jp: はぁ？　おい新入り、表出なさいよ
records.en_original: Excuse me? Let's take this outside, new girl.
records.en: Excuse me? Let's take this outside, new girl.

records.jp: また始まった
records.en_original: There they go again.
records.en: There they go again.

records.jp: 喧嘩するとこは変わらないんだね
records.en_original: I guess we won't be able to get them to stop fighting completely.
records.en: I guess we won't be able to get them to stop fighting completely.

records.jp: てか表ってどこだし
records.en_original: And aren't we already outside?
records.en: And aren't we already outside?

records.jp: まあまあ、いいじゃないの。<CR>いっぱいいたほうが賑やかで楽しいし
records.en_original: Aw, come on. It's a lot more fun this way.
records.en: Aw, come on. It's a lot more fun this way.

records.jp: 楽しくない！！！！
records.en_original: I'm not having fun!
records.en: I'm not having fun!
